summary: Iteration 2 testing of LICMAN new features (SSH adapter, SMTP alerts, Expiry, localStorage persistence). Backend: 16/16 NEW pytests PASSED + 13/13 prior pytests still green (total 29/29). All new endpoints verified: GET/PUT /api/settings (with smtp_password masking + smtp_password_set), POST /api/settings/test-email (400 when unconfigured, returns {ok,error} when SMTP unreachable, logs AlertEvent kind=test), GET /api/alerts (sorted desc), POST /api/alerts/evaluate (creates saturation alerts), GET /api/expiry (sorted expired->nearest->permanent, status field), PUT /api/servers/{id}/ssh (persists SshConfig), PUT /api/servers/{id}/adapter (mock/ssh + 422 on invalid), POST /api/servers/{id}/ssh/test ({ok,message,mocked:true}), reread/restart record exec_log mode in last_action, /api/checkouts triggers evaluate_alerts side-effect, /api/seed/reset clears alert_events. Frontend: Header has 3 nav links (nav-dashboard/nav-expiry/nav-settings), localStorage 'licman_prefs_v1' persists autoRefresh/vendorFilter/searchQuery/lastServerId correctly, /expiry page renders summary tiles + filters + sorted table with color-coded ExpiryBadge per row, /settings page renders complete SMTP form + O365 preset + alert toggles + Recent Alerts panel. CRITICAL GAP: ServerDetail Connection tab (tab-ssh) is COMPLETELY MISSING — only 5 old tabs (checkouts/license/options/reservations/audit). SshConfigPanel is unreachable via UI. Feature cells on ServerDetail also lack ExpiryBadge with days-remaining (only show seat usage bars).

minor.issue: SMTP delivery always fails in sandbox (no reachable mail server) — expected/mocked. Endpoint correctly returns 200 with ok=false, error=<smtp error> and logs an AlertEvent. No fix needed.
Saturation alert generation depends on random checkout simulation (random.randint up to total). Single evaluation may not fire; tests loop up to 10-15 times. Acceptable for mocked demo.

ui_bugs.issue: Connection tab (tab-ssh) is COMPLETELY MISSING from ServerDetail page. Only 5 tabs render (tab-checkouts, tab-license, tab-options, tab-reservations, tab-audit). SshConfigPanel with adapter-mode toggle, ssh-host/port/username/lmutil/auth/private-key/password inputs and ssh-test-btn / ssh-save-btn is unreachable via UI. Backend endpoints work — just the UI tab+panel is not wired in.

Feature cells (feature-cell-Innovus, feature-cell-Genus, ...) show only seat usage bars (e.g., 8/8 red, 5/6 red, 7/12 amber). The required ExpiryBadge with days-remaining + color coding per the spec is NOT rendered inside feature cells.

Summary tiles render visually (EXPIRED 0, CRITICAL 0, WARN 9, OK 5, PERMANENT 0) but data-testid attributes are MISSING: expiry-summary-expired, expiry-summary-critical, expiry-summary-warning, expiry-summary-ok, expiry-summary-permanent. Also expiry-table testid missing on the table element. expiry-search IS present.

STARTTLS toggle and the 3 alert toggles (master/saturation/expiry) render as visible ON/OFF / ENABLED/DISABLED buttons but lack the expected data-testids: starttls-toggle, alert-master-toggle, alert-saturation-toggle, alert-expiry-toggle. All other testids found (smtp-host, smtp-port, smtp-username, smtp-password, from-address, recipients, expiry-warn-days, o365-preset-btn, send-test-email-btn, save-settings-btn).

Vendor filter chips use data-testid 'filter-vendor-ALL/cadence/synopsys/mentor' (not 'vendor-filter-all') and search input uses 'checkout-search' (not 'search-input'). Naming differs from review spec. Functional but inconsistent.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py now ~857 lines — over the 700-line guideline. Consider splitting into modules: models.py, helpers.py (smtp/alerts/ssh), routes_servers.py, routes_settings.py, routes_expiry.py.
send_smtp_email is synchronous and runs inside an async endpoint; under load this will block the event loop. Wrap with asyncio.to_thread(..) or use aiosmtplib.
SMTP password is stored in plaintext in MongoDB settings collection. Acceptable for single-user demo but should be encrypted-at-rest for prod.
_alert_throttled uses string ISO comparison on timestamps which works for UTC ISO strings but is fragile if timezone-aware/naive mix ever leaks in.
evaluate_alerts re-generates random checkouts via generate_checkouts() — saturation alerts are non-deterministic. Production swap should pull live lmstat data.
PUT /settings response strips smtp_password and adds smtp_password_set — good. But GET /settings still returns the raw password from DB. Consider masking on GET as well.
AdapterPayload doesn't validate adapter_mode='ssh' requires ssh.enabled=True — user can put adapter=ssh while ssh.enabled=False, then ssh_execute falls back to mock silently.

success_rate.frontend: ~70% — Dashboard prefs persistence, Expiry page, Settings page all work visually; ServerDetail SSH Connection tab is MISSING entirely; feature cell ExpiryBadge missing; several data-testid gaps.
